Mara: Quick brainstorm  new benchmark angle: 'SLA ladder'  show which configs buy you what tail protection and at what $/1M. Move away from single avg lines.

Devin: Yes. Ops teams choose by tails, not means. Good call.

Sam: Design brief (3 panels)
- Panel 1: SLA ladder  P(99th <= X ms) vs $/1M tokens, one line per config (lite, balanced, cached)
- Panel 2: cost stack for 100k queries (model, batching, cache savings, infra)
- Panel 3: knob matrix: recommended settings by persona (chat/search/embeds)

Leah: Please drop quick numbers so I can mock.

Mara: Tiny CSV for Panel 1 (latency_ms,lite,balanced,cached)
``` 
latency_ms,lite,balanced,cached
170,0.54,0.81,0.94
220,0.72,0.92,0.987
270,0.86,0.97,0.997
330,0.95,0.994,0.9994
```
Cost ticks ($ per 1M tokens): lite=1500,balanced=800,cached=360
```
config,cost_per_1M
lite,1500
balanced,800
cached,360
```

Priya: Hero claim options (new wording)
1) "SLA ladder: choose the tail you protect and the price you pay"
2) "Pay-for-performance inference: align SLA and unit economics"
3) "Match latency SLAs to spend  predictable tail economics for production"

Sam: 1 is intriguing for product storytelling. 2 works for ad copy.

Leah: Webinar hook: 30 min (15 demo, 10 Q&A, 5 recap). Demo flow: baseline under load -> flip to balanced -> enable cached -> show 99th trace + cost overlay. We'll capture the flip event for trace markers.

Devin: Eng can script the load and emit a 99th trace every 15s; we'll annotate toggles. ETA 72 hours for a clean recording.

Tom: Lead-routing: tag engaged folks ["lead:tail-savings","lead:pay-for-performance","lead:embeddings"] and route to nurture funnel: SLA ladder one-pager -> 5-min clip -> config playbook.

Mara: Action owners
- Design (Sam): mock the 3 panels from the CSV by Thu EOD
- Eng (Devin): traffic script + annotated 99th traces + 5-min highlight in 3 days
- Content (Priya): one-pager + webinar script; pick hero by Fri
- Growth (Tom): tag wiring + LP + nurture flow

Sam: Draft CTA for LP: "Pick your SLA ladder  watch the 5-minute demo to see the tradeoffs."

Leah: I'll scaffold the signup page and slides; target webinar in 10 business days.

Mara: Drop early PNGs and the recorded trace here and I'll finalize hero. Thanks.

marketing-bot: Sprint created: "sla-ladder-benchmark" due in 9 days. :rocket:
